rows.body_you: Ambition is not a character flaw, and neither is leaving a system that keeps moving the reward. The trap is working twice as hard for an approval that never arrives. Once that pattern takes over, every new boss, title, or institution can start looking like another version of the same fight. Some authority deserves to be challenged. Some responsibility is still worth having. The difference is easier to see once approval stops being the prize.

The goal is not to fit everywhere. It is to stop treating every room like the old one.

rows.body_you: Pisces likes to dissolve, to blur the edges, but Lilith cuts through the fog. Past experience can make the options look like absorb everything or disappear. When those are the only two settings, every demand can start feeling like too much and checking out can start feeling like relief. Some people will keep taking support as long as it is available, then resent the person who finally runs out. A limit creates another option: staying present without absorbing everything.
